features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, capturing the relative magnitude of these two continuous descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree models can split on this ratio directly, which might represent a specific molecular property balance.

features.name: v8_v30_interaction
features.description: Product of V8 and V30, representing a nonlinear interaction between two features with larger numerical ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-computed interaction term that a tree model would otherwise need multiple splits to approximate.

features.name: v12_positive_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether V12 is greater than zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a hard threshold that tree models can use as a direct binary split.

features.name: v15_v39_diff
features.description: Difference between V15 and V39, capturing the divergence between these two similarly-scaled continuous features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the tree to split on the relative difference rather than absolute values of either feature.

features.name: v16_v41_sum
features.description: Sum of V16 and V41, aggregating two count-like features with relatively large maximum values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality by combining related count features into a single aggregate sum.

features.name: v3_v5_v7_total
features.description: Sum of V3, V5, and V7, representing an aggregated count of specific molecular substructures or properties.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a combined metric that might be more robust than individual sparse counts.

features.name: v28_magnitude
features.description: Absolute value of V28, focusing on the magnitude of the descriptor regardless of its sign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model identify significant deviations from zero without needing symmetric splits.

features.name: v31_log_transform
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of V31 to compress its right-skewed distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme values, making it easier for the tree to find meaningful splits in the lower range.

features.name: rare_feature_presence
features.description: Boolean indicator if any of the rare features V19, V24, or V25 are greater than zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups sparse, rare features into a single, more frequent indicator for easier splitting.

features.name: high_v8_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether V8 exceeds its training set mean of 36.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-computed threshold split based on the central tendency of the feature.

features.name: molecular_complexity_assessment
features.description: A semantic assessment of the overall molecular complexity based on the combination of various count features (e.g., V16, V41, V30).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic structural complexity that might not be easily represented by simple arithmetic combinations.

features.name: structural_anomaly_score
features.description: Evaluates if the combination of continuous descriptors (e.g., V12, V28) suggests an unusual or outlier molecular structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the tree model isolate and handle potential outliers or rare structural conformations.
